units: <cite ref="Pesachim 86b:9">Pes. 86ᵇ</cite> <he>השׁוֹתֶה כוסו וכ׳</he> he who drinks his cupful at one draught is called greedy (<cite ref="C01261"><he>גַּרְגְּרָן</he></cite>).

<cite ref="Berakhot 51a:8">Ber. 51ᵃ</cite> <he>מקבלו … ושׁוֹתֵהוּ בשמאל</he> he must receive it (the medicine, v. <cite ref="A01489"><he>אִסְפַּרְגּוֹס</he></cite>) with his right hand, and drink it (take it to his lips) with his left hand.
<cite ref="Berakhot 51b:8">Ib.ᵇ</cite> <he>השותה כפלים</he> he who drinks an even number of cups (v. <cite ref="G00121"><he>זוּג</he></cite>).

<cite ref="Tosefta Sotah 15:11">Tosef. Sot. XV, 11</cite>; <cite ref="Bava Batra 60b:11">B. Bath. 60ᵇ</cite> <he>כשחרב … ושלא לִשְׁתּוֹת יין</he> when the Temple was destroyed, … there were many scrupulous persons (<he>פרושים</he>, determined) not to eat meat nor drink wine.

<cite ref="Bava Batra 60b:11">Ib.</cite> <he>נִשְׁתֶּה יין וכ׳</he> should we drink wine, of which libations were offered on the altar? <cite ref="Bava Batra 60b:12">Ib.</cite> <he>מים לא נשתה וכ׳</he> then let us drink no water, because water libation has ceased.
<cite ref="Ketubot 8b:8">Keth. 8ᵇ</cite> <he>רבים שָׁתוּ רבים יִשְׁתּוּ</he> many have drank (the cup of mourning), many shall drink, v. <cite ref="M02989"><he>מִשְׁתֶּה</he></cite>.
Nidd. 24ᵇ כמה … שָׁתַת אמו וכ׳ how much unmixed wine the mother of this embryo must have drunk!; a. fr.—Part. pass. שָׁתוּי being under the influence of drink.

<cite ref="Eruvin 64a:9">Erub. 64ᵃ</cite> <he>שְׁתוּי יין אל וכ׳</he> Ms. M. (ed. only <cite ref="U01853"><he>שָׁ׳</he></cite>) one feeling the wine must not pray, contrad. to <cite ref="U01136"><he>שִׁכּוֹר</he></cite>, q. v.
Lev. R. s. 12 שנכנסו שְׁתוּיֵי יין וכ׳ they (Nadab and Abihu) entered the Tabernacle while under the influence of wine; a. fr.—[Hif. from שָׁקָה q. v.]
